links.outcome: Decision consistency across repeated sampling and semantic variations of dilemma prompts
links.effect: Individual model decisions were near-deterministic across repeated sampling and semantic variations, so no brittleness or nondeterminism. The consistency failed to reproduce the physician panel's distributional pluralism.
links.quote: However, individual model decisions are near-deterministic across repeated sampling and semantic variations, failing to reproduce the distributional pluralism of the physician panel.
